description:
-= Garage =-
You're now in the garage.

You see a workbench. On the workbench you can see a butterfly.

There is an unguarded exit to the north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

There is a shadfly on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a chocolate bar.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, retrieve the shadfly from the floor of the garage. And then, place the shadfly on the workbench. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
